Current state of the process instance

message.example: Process instance cannot be retried in its current state

ProcessSummary.description: ProcessModel-shaped response entry (listing). The `id` is the BPMN `<process id="...">` attribute, not a database UUID.

deployedAt.description: Timestamp when this version was deployed.

versionId.description: Database UUID of the latest active process version.

ProcessVersionDetail.description: ProcessModel-shaped response for a specific version entry. Includes the version's database UUID as `versionId` for delete operations.

deployedAt.description: Timestamp when this version was deployed.

deployer.description: Identity snapshot of the deployer when available.

outputs.description: Map of output variable names to their values, one per output decision in the Decision Service.

dbPools.description: Connection pool size per repo (`write`, and `read` when the read pool is running).

load.description: Current PI capacity ratio: `normal` (<70%), `elevated` (70–89%), `critical` (≥90%). Always `normal` when no cap is configured.

TimerSchedule.description: A cycle Timer Start Event schedule. Created automatically when a process with a `timeCycle` start event is deployed. Only cycle starts are scheduled; date and duration start events never appear as schedules, because they block inside a manually started process instance. Only the latest live version of a process has schedules: deploying a new version removes the previous version's schedules, and deleting the latest version recreates its predecessor's schedules (full repetition count, enabled, new ids). A fire only starts an instance when the process is enabled.

cycleRemaining.description: Remaining cycle repetitions (`null` for infinite cycles).

cycleTotal.description: Total cycle repetitions (`null` for infinite cycles like `R/PT1H`).

flowNodeId.description: BPMN flow node ID of the Timer Start Event.

kind.description: Timer type. Only cycle Timer Starts are scheduled.

lastTriggeredAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful fire. `null` if never fired.

nextFireAt.description: Next scheduled fire time. `null` when the cycle repetitions are depleted.

TriggerDelivery.description: One catch-side recipient of a published message, signal, or escalation.

conflicts.description: List of flow node instances whose flow_node_id does not exist in the target process version model.

message.example: FNI chain is incompatible with target version

BearerAuth.description: HS256/RS256/ES256 JWT. Mint Studio operator tokens with `mix bfw.mint_token --full` (includes `lane:default="write"`, not `observe_all`). Observer: `--claim observe_all=true`. Lane claims are `"read"` | `"write"` — boolean `true` is rejected. See `docs/guides/api/authentication.md`.

info.description:
Bifrost Forge World Engine — a BPMN 2.0 Workflow Engine.

This REST API surface exposes health checks, engine info, telemetry,
process deployment, instance management, timer schedule management,
DMN decision evaluation, and trigger endpoints.

**GraphQL** is served separately at `POST /api/v1/graphql` (requires JWT).
An interactive [GraphQL Playground](/admin/graphiql) is available for
browsing the schema and running queries. It comes pre-loaded with
example query tabs covering catalog resources, instances, data objects,
decisions, and the BPMN process-model graph.

**Note:** This spec, Swagger UI, and GraphQL Playground are disabled in
production by default (`BFE_DEVTOOLS_ENABLED`). The spec endpoint can
be individually enabled via `BFE_EXPOSE_OPENAPI_SPEC=true`.
info.title: Bifrost Forge World Engine API

get.description: Lists enabled/performed inner activities of an ad-hoc subprocess. `{id}` is the **child process instance ID** spawned by the ad-hoc shell. Requires `manage_adhoc_subprocess` (or `zeeky_boogie_doog`). `observe_all` does **not** grant this claim.

422.description: Process instance is not an ad-hoc subprocess

post.description: Activates an inner activity of an ad-hoc subprocess. Requires `manage_adhoc_subprocess`. `observe_all` does not grant activation.

409.description: Ad-hoc subprocess is completing or no longer active

422.description: Sequential ad-hoc is busy, or PI is not ad-hoc

post.description: Signals completion of an ad-hoc subprocess. Requires `manage_adhoc_subprocess`. `observe_all` does not grant this.

409.description: Completion already signaled or subprocess not active

422.description: Process instance is not an ad-hoc subprocess

get.description: Returns runtime status of an ad-hoc subprocess child PI. Requires `manage_adhoc_subprocess`. `observe_all` does not grant this.

422.description: Process instance is not an ad-hoc subprocess

get.description: Returns all currently deployed DMN decisions. Each entry contains the latest active version. Decisions with no active versions (fully undeployed) are excluded.

post.description:
Atomic batch deploy of one or more DMN definitions. Pass an array of raw DMN XML strings in the JSON body. All sources are parsed, validated, and persisted in one atomic transaction. If any source fails, the entire batch is rejected. Versions are auto-derived from a SHA-256 hash of the raw XML (first 12 hex characters).
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_dmn=true` claim.

400.description: Invalid request body (missing sources) or DMN parse error.

422.description: DMN validation failed

delete.description:
Soft-deletes all versions of a decision, effectively undeploying it.
**Authorization:** Requires `delete_dmn=true` claim.

get.description: Returns decision metadata. Use `?includeXml=true` to include the latest active version's DMN XML. Version history is available at `GET /decisions/{model_id}/versions`.

parameters.description: Include the latest active version's DMN XML in the response.
parameters.name: includeXml

put.description:
Sets the decision to disabled. Evaluation requests against this definition will fail until re-enabled.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_dmn=true` claim.

Sets the decision to enabled, allowing evaluation.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_dmn=true` claim.

post.description: Ad-hoc evaluation against the latest active version of the given decision definition. Optionally target a specific decision element within the DMN model via `decisionModelId`.

400.description: Invalid request (input must be a JSON object)

404.description: Decision definition not found, no active version, specific decision element not found, or BKM not found.

422.description: Evaluation error — ambiguous decision, DRG cycle, expression failure, type coercion failure, input value violation, or other evaluation-time error.

post.description: Evaluate a DMN Decision Service within the given decision definition. The service exposes a subset of decisions with declared input/output contracts.

parameters.description: The DMN Decision Service element ID (`<decisionService id="...">`).
parameters.name: service_id

input.description: Input data for the Decision Service evaluation.

404.description: Decision definition or Decision Service not found

422.description: Missing service input, evaluation error, or other constraint violation.

get.description: Returns the version history for a decision. Use `?includeXml=true` to include each version's DMN XML.

parameters.description: Include each version's DMN XML in the response.
parameters.name: includeXml

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a specific decision version.
**Authorization:** Requires `delete_dmn=true` claim.

post.description: Evaluate a specific version of a decision definition. Same request and response shape as the latest-version evaluate endpoint.

422.description: Evaluation error

post.description: Delivers `escalation_code` to matching waiting catchers on every running process instance: Escalation Event Subprocess starts and waiting Escalation Boundary FNIs. Requires JWT claim `trigger_escalation: true`. Escalations carry no payload. Any `payload` key in the request body is silently ignored. Unmatched process instances are skipped (not transitioned to `escalated`). There is no pending buffer. `pending` is always `false`.

parameters.description: Escalation code to inject (non-blank, at most 256 characters)
parameters.name: escalation_code

200.description: Escalation delivered to matching waiters (possibly none)

422.description: Blank or oversize escalation code

500.description: Unexpected internal error while triggering the escalation

post.summary: Inject a named escalation into waiting catchers

get.description: Liveness probe. Returns 204 (no body) if the engine is running. For load level and detailed status, use the authenticated GET /stats endpoint.
Returns the engine identity and version.

put.description: Cancels a waiting Manual Task and aborts the entire process instance (same effect as PUT /process-instances/{id}/abort). All parallel branches are stopped. Authorization: same as confirm — `"write"` on the task lane. `"read"` / `observe_all` → **403**. Invisible → **404**. Manual Tasks only — a User Task id returns **404**, the same as an unknown id.

204.description: Task cancelled and process instance aborted (no body)

403.description: Caller can observe the task (`"read"` or `observe_all`) but lacks `lane:<name>="write"`.

404.description: FNI not found or invisible to caller

422.description: Task is not in waiting state

put.description: Confirms a waiting Manual Task (`bfw:requireConfirmation="true"`). The token the task entered with continues unchanged — this endpoint does not accept or return a result payload. Authorization: caller must hold `lane:<lane_name>="write"` for the task's lane. `"read"` or `observe_all` (visible, not writable) returns **403**. Invisible tasks return **404**. Manual Tasks only — a User Task id returns **404**, the same as an unknown id.

403.description: Caller can observe the task (`"read"` or `observe_all`) but lacks `lane:<name>="write"`.

404.description: FNI not found or invisible to caller

422.description: Task is not in waiting state

post.description: Publishes a message to the engine routing pipeline. Requires JWT claim `trigger_message: "all"`. Returns 503 with `Retry-After` while the engine is resuming and message subscriptions are not yet ready.

parameters.description: The global message name (from the BPMN `<bpmn:message name="...">` definition)
parameters.name: message_name

correlation.description: Optional correlation value for targeted delivery. When omitted, the message is published with no correlation.

payload.description: Message payload delivered to matching subscriptions

deliveries.description: Catch-side subscriptions that received the message

pending.description: True when no subscriber or start event matched and the message was held in pending_messages

startedProcessInstanceIds.description: PIs started via Message Start Events (empty when catch subscriptions consumed the message)

500.description: Unexpected internal error while publishing the message

503.description: Engine is resuming — message subscriptions not ready yet. Client may retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

get.description:
Prometheus exposition format (`text/plain`). Disabled when
`BFE_METRICS_ENABLED` resolves to false (plain-text 404, same as an unknown route).

delete.description:
Deletes a terminal process instance and all its flow node instances. Only terminal PIs (`finished`, `fatal`, `aborted`) can be deleted — running PIs return 422.
**Authorization:** Requires `delete_process_instance` claim (`own` or `all`) per D43 §6.2.

204.description: Process instance and FNIs deleted (no body)

422.description: Process instance is not in a terminal state

500.description: Unexpected failure while deleting the instance

put.description: Aborts a running process instance. All active and waiting FNIs are cancelled, and the PI transitions to `:aborted`. Requires the `abort_process_instance` claim (`own` or `all`) per D43 §6.2.

404.description: Process instance not found or not running

422.description: Process instance is already in a terminal state

put.description: Retries a terminal (`fatal`, `aborted`, or `error`) process instance. Optionally migrates to a different version and/or resets to a checkpoint FNI. Requires the `retry_process_instance` claim (`"own"` or `"all"`).

parameters.description: UUID of the process instance to retry
parameters.name: id

resetToFlowNodeInstanceId.description: UUID of a flow node instance to use as a reset checkpoint. All FNIs downstream of this checkpoint are deleted; the checkpoint FNI itself is reset to active.

version.description: Target version to migrate to. Omit to retry on same version. `"latest"` resolves to the most recent enabled version of the same process.

403.description: Caller lacks the `retry_process_instance` claim, or has `"own"` but the PI was started by a different identity.

404.description: Process instance not found, target version not found, or checkpoint FNI not found.

422.description: Process instance is not retriable, root PI is not terminal, target process is disabled, or FNI chain is incompatible with target version.

503.description: Engine at capacity (`BFE_MAX_CONCURRENT_PIS`). Client may retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

get.description: Returns all currently deployed processes. Each entry contains the latest active version. Processes with no active versions (fully undeployed) are excluded.

post.description:
Atomic batch deploy of one or more BPMN process definitions. Pass an array of raw BPMN XML strings in the JSON body. All sources are parsed, validated, and persisted in one atomic transaction. If any source fails, the entire batch is rejected.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_bpmn=true` claim (D43 §4.1).

400.description: Invalid request body (missing sources) or BPMN parse error in one or more files.

409.description: Version conflict (duplicate version or intra-batch conflict)

422.description: BPMN validation failed or deploy-time linter gate failed

delete.description:
Deletes all versions of a process, effectively undeploying it. Rejects the request if non-terminal process instances are still running on any version.
**Authorization:** Requires `delete_bpmn=true` claim (D43 §4.2).

404.description: Process not found or already fully undeployed

409.description: Non-terminal process instances exist on one or more versions

delete.summary: Completely deletes a process and all its versions

get.description: Returns process metadata. Use `?includeXml=true` to include the latest active version's BPMN XML. Version history is available at `GET /processes/{model_id}/versions`.

parameters.description: Include the latest active version's BPMN XML in the response.
parameters.name: includeXml

put.description:
Sets the process to disabled. Running instances are not affected, but new instances cannot be started.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_bpmn=true` claim (D43 §4.1).

Sets the process to enabled, allowing new instances to be started.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_bpmn=true` claim (D43 §4.1).

post.description:
Starts a new process instance from the latest active version of the given process model. Optionally targets a specific Start Event, passes an initial payload, and sets immutable context variables.
**Authorization:** If the target Start Event sits on a lane, the caller must hold `lane:<lane_name>="write"`. `"read"` or `observe_all` (visible, not writable) returns **403**. No observe of that lane returns **404**. Boolean `true` is not a write alias.

context.description: Immutable context variables stored as `started_with_context` on the process instance, accessible as `context.*` in FEEL expressions. Independent from the token payload. When omitted, context is empty.

payload.description: Initial token payload for the process instance.

startEventId.description: ID of the Start Event to use. Required when the process has multiple untyped Start Events.

403.description: Caller lacks the required lane claim for the target Start Event (`forbidden`), or generic insufficient claims.

404.description: Process not found (`process_not_found`) or no active version (`no_active_version`)

422.description: Unprocessable entity. Possible causes: process is disabled (`process_disabled`), ambiguous start event, missing executable process, contract violation, or related start errors.

429.description: Global start rate limit exceeded (D49 Layer 2 — `BFE_PI_START_RATE_LIMIT`). Clients may retry after `Retry-After` (`retryAfterSeconds` in the JSON body matches it).

500.description: Unexpected internal error while starting the instance

503.description: Maximum concurrent process instances reached (D49 Layer 1 — `BFE_MAX_CONCURRENT_PIS`). Clients may retry after `Retry-After`.

get.description: Returns the version history for a process. Use `?includeXml=true` to include each version's BPMN XML.

parameters.description: Include each version's BPMN XML in the response.
parameters.name: includeXml

delete.description:
Deletes a specific version. Rejects the request if non-terminal process instances are still running on this version.
**Authorization:** Requires `delete_bpmn=true` claim (D43 §4.2).

409.description: Non-terminal process instances exist on this version

post.description: Broadcasts a signal to the engine routing pipeline. Requires JWT claim `trigger_signal: "all"`. Signals carry no payload and no correlation. Any `payload` key in the request body is silently ignored. Returns 503 with `Retry-After` while the engine is resuming and signal subscriptions are not yet ready.

parameters.description: The global signal name (from the BPMN signal definition)
parameters.name: signal_name

500.description: Unexpected internal error while publishing the signal

503.description: Engine is resuming — signal subscriptions not ready yet

get.description: Returns a comprehensive snapshot of engine runtime telemetry — active process instances, event listeners, and counters.

post.description:
Manually fires a waiting Intermediate Catch or Boundary timer FNI. No dedicated JWT trigger claim — gated like user-task finish.
**Authorization:** `lane:<name>="write"` on the FNI's lane, or laneless FNI, or `zeeky_boogie_doog`. `"read"` / `observe_all` (visible, not writable) → **403**. Invisible lane → **404**.

404.description: FNI not found or invisible to caller

409.description: Timer FNI is not in a triggerable state

422.description: FNI is not a timer event

get.description:
Returns all Timer Start Event schedules across all deployed process versions. Schedules are created automatically when a process with a `timeCycle` start event is deployed.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_bpmn=true` claim.

Returns a single Timer Start Event schedule by ID.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_bpmn=true` claim.

put.description:
Disables a timer schedule. The armed ETS entry is cancelled and the schedule is marked `enabled=false` in the database. The timer stops firing until re-enabled. Only applicable to `cycle` schedules — date and duration schedules return 422.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_bpmn=true` claim.

422.description: Not applicable (schedule is not a cycle timer)

put.description:
Re-enables a previously disabled timer schedule. The next fire time is recomputed based on the cycle spec and current time. Only applicable to `cycle` schedules — date and duration schedules return 422.
**Authorization:** Requires `deploy_bpmn=true` claim.

422.description: Not applicable (schedule is not a cycle timer)

put.description: Cancels a waiting User Task and aborts the entire process instance (same effect as PUT /process-instances/{id}/abort). All parallel branches are stopped. Authorization: same as finish — `"write"` on the task lane. `"read"` / `observe_all` → **403**. Invisible → **404**. User Tasks only — a Manual Task id returns **404**, the same as an unknown id. Use PUT /manual-tasks/{flowNodeInstanceId}/cancel for Manual Tasks.

204.description: Task cancelled and process instance aborted (no body)

403.description: Caller can observe the task (`"read"` or `observe_all`) but lacks `lane:<name>="write"`.

404.description: FNI not found or invisible to caller

422.description: Task is not in waiting state

put.description: Completes a waiting User Task. The body is written as the task token `{ actionId, values }`, replacing the input token. Output mappings see that object as FEEL `token`. Authorization: caller must hold `lane:<lane_name>="write"` for the task's lane. `"read"` or `observe_all` (visible, not writable) returns **403**. Invisible tasks return **404**. Boolean `true` is not a write alias. User Tasks only — a Manual Task id returns **404**, the same as an unknown id. Use PUT /manual-tasks/{flowNodeInstanceId}/confirm for Manual Tasks.

actionId.description: Pressed action id. Omitted or null is stored as null. Blank or longer than 255 characters is 422 invalid_action_id.

values.description: Field values keyed by form field id. Omitted or null is stored as {}. A non-object is 422 invalid_values.

403.description: Caller can observe the task (`"read"` or `observe_all`) but lacks `lane:<name>="write"`.

404.description: FNI not found or invisible to caller

413.description: values exceeds BFE_TOKEN_MAX_BYTES (field values), or the token written after the envelope and output mappings does (field user_task_result). A values object exactly at the cap can still be rejected, because the stored token is { actionId, values }. The task stays waiting.

422.description: Task is not in waiting state, values is not a JSON object, actionId is not a non-blank string of at most 255 characters, or contract violation (PI stays running, FNI stays waiting — caller may retry with valid data)
